note: Curated for Ahentic. Distilled from Core block.json. Prefer live ahentic-browser/get-block-type for unknown/third-party blocks. Rich-text attrs: pass HTML strings; Ahentic converts.
rules: For core/* text blocks, edit with update-block-attributes / replace-blocks / set-blocks — do not call get-block-type first.
get-block-type requires {name}, never a block ref alone. Use only for non-core or after an attribute update fails.
Rich-text attributes (content/text/caption/citation): pass HTML strings (e.g. per-letter <span style="color:#…">).
Address blocks with short refs (b1, b2) from get-blocks / get-selection — never send Gutenberg clientId UUID hashes.
Pass block trees as {name, attributes, innerBlocks} objects for createBlock; do not pass plain-text stubs.

core/heading.title: Heading
core/heading.tip: Post/page title field is the document H1 — prefer level 2+ in the body (playbook post-title-headings). Change wording via attributes.content HTML; level for h1–h6.

core/paragraph.title: Paragraph
core/paragraph.tip: Body copy lives in content as HTML.

core/button.title: Button
core/button.tip: Label is text (rich-text), link is url — not content.

core/image.title: Image
core/image.tip: Set url/alt/id; caption is rich-text HTML.

core/list.title: List
core/list.tip: Prefer innerBlocks of core/list-item; avoid legacy values HTML when possible.

core/list-item.title: List Item
core/list-item.tip: Child of core/list; edit content HTML.

core/quote.title: Quote
core/quote.tip: Modern quotes often use inner paragraph blocks plus citation.

core/html.title: Custom HTML
core/html.tip: Escape hatch for arbitrary markup (e.g. multicolor spans in an h2 wrapper).
